India's Richest Indians in Tech and Business

A list of India's wealthiest individuals in the technology and business sectors has been published. Among those named are Shiv Nadar, Azim Premji, and Narayan Murthy, identified as among the top five richest in the tech world. The coverage also addresses who holds the position of India's richest person if not Mukesh Ambani, and ranks figures like Gautam Adani and the Mittal-Birla group.
